'''Intelligence officer''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]]. An [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Commando (intelligence officer)|ARC trooper]] served as an intelligence [[Officer/Legends|officer]] with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Intelligence Officers were also members of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] assigned to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] bases to interpret Intelligence reports. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] made use of Intelligence officers. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Biros Baran]] served as [[Eyrie Base]]'s Intelligence Officer in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
